text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san~! Did you watch me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: This is the real me. No—the real "us"!
choice_data_list:
You looked like a completely different 
person.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was able to run freely for the 
first time in a while~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A sense of responsibility for your sake, 
Trainer, and the sense of security from 
having you by my side.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The two blend together and envelop me, 
making my back feel so wonderfully 
light...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was finally able to pull off... a run 
packed with real substance!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So does this mean I'm going to be okay 
now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then, could you let me do that? That thing 
you mentioned back at the Sumire Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last—before everyone. On this grand 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, there's a good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer... I was finally able to 
become the person I wanted to be.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... for keeping you waiting. 
Thank you... for waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... you are my pride and joy. 
Seeing you grow into such a fine person.
choice_data_list: No, thank YOU for raising me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, the two of us learned so much. 
Lessons that will lead toward becoming 
first-rate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With how Super Creek is now, she can hold 
her own even in the mixed-generation Grand 
Prix. Surely!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the next objective is...
choice_data_list: Shall we go with year-end Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Nakayama at year's end...!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. It's a little scary, but I 
want to take on this challenge with you, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —To the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, took yer sweet time, didn't ya? Got 
all that talent and yet ya kept me waitin' 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now all the superstars will finally be 
lined up at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're facin' me, the strongest in the 
Senior Class, and the Classic Class's 
strongest "Uncrowned Champion."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Right, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tama...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'm so hungry...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: *Facepalm.* That doesn't follow at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The passionate gazes of her rivals were 
also directed toward Super Creek.
